theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (M N : Set (Euclid P)) (u e : Euclid P) (r₀ s : ℝ), ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ u e = 0 → 0 < s → s < r₀ → IsOpen N → r₀ • u ∈ N → M ∩ N = (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 • (Real.cos q.2 • u + Real.sin q.2 • e)) '' (Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) ×ˢ Ioo (-s) s) → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ M ∩ ball (r₀ • u) δ = (Submodule.span ℝ {u, e} : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball (r₀ • u) δ
